reviews.text: Exceptional team at all times. One of the few groomers who understand what it takes for senior dogs.

Spablin is a wonderful salon! I’ve been going there for almost two years, and everyone is always so kind and accommodating. The owner, Mirelu, is incredibly understanding, and her entire team is just as lovely.

For the first time, we tried grooming with Bella, and I couldn’t be happier! If you have a Yorkie and want to keep that adorable fluffy teddy-bear face, she is amazing. She is extremely precise, asks all the right questions, takes the time to really listen to what you want, and suggests the best grooming techniques for your dog and breed.

This is honestly one of the best cuts he has ever had. He looks like a little teddy bear! Everything is so perfectly trimmed—not a single hair out of place. I love it so much, I joked that I would let Bella cut my own hair! 😂

Thank you so much, Spableen . You are the best! ❤️🐶

The best!!! They really took the time to understand the type of grooming I wanted for my dog. They adapted the grooming sessions to my excited puppy to make sure she had enjoyable sessions. Amazing communication. Highly recommend!

I rarely leave Google reviews, but this time it's worth it! The team is super friendly, welcoming, gentle, and professional. I entrusted them with my 7-month-old Scottish Terrier puppy for a traditional Scottish cut with plucking, and I'm blown away by the result. It's done perfectly! My dog ​​left feeling relaxed; she'd made a new friend during her grooming session! My dog ​​looks gorgeous with her new haircut 😍

A huge thank you to the entire team for this first experience, which was simply perfect for our miniature poodle!

The service was impeccable from start to finish: professional, attentive, and truly warm. It's clear you love animals and are dedicated to providing them with the best possible care.

We are absolutely delighted with the result and its precision. Thank you again to the whole team for your wonderful work!

I came with my dog, who is used to having his nails trimmed. Since it was his first time there, I asked to stay with him, but I was refused entry. At the time, I didn't insist.

A few minutes later, I started hearing my dog ​​howling and crying. At no point did I hear the woman try to reassure or calm him down.

So I went to see what was happening. At first, she hadn't even seen me. My dog ​​was completely panicked, hyperventilating, pulling so hard on the grooming collar that he was choking himself. The woman, for her part, was anything but gentle with him.

When she finally noticed I was there, she started laughing and saying something like, "He doesn't like having his paws touched." “Yet, simply by talking to my dog ​​and reassuring him, he calmed down almost immediately.

What bothers me even more is that before this experience, he never had a problem with having his paws touched. Now he won’t even let me touch them without becoming suspicious or stressed.

I understand that a dog can be nervous during grooming, but when an animal is in such an obvious state of panic, you have to know when to stop, reassure them, and adapt your approach. I am extremely disappointed by this experience and especially saddened to see that my dog ​​now seems to have a fear he didn’t have before.”

Took my dog Peanut here for the first time recently and we had the best experience. Peanut is really sensitive to nail trimming and yet they managed to do it, she looked amazing after her appointment, too.
My favourite part was the dog report card!! Literally the cutest thing ever. The environment is super calm and relaxing inside this groomer as well. We will 100% be back :) (p.s their dog store across the street is awesome too - the owner helped me select a bunch of treats that my dog really loved)

My dog loves getting groomed here and he always comes back out looking so handsome and smelling so nice.
Thank you spableen!
We're so glad you and your pup had a great experience, and we can't wait to see you both again soon!

I’ve been bringing Brownie here since he was just a little puppy because I wanted to get him used to grooming from an early age. We’ve been coming here for more than six months now, and I’m always so happy with how he looks after every appointment!
Brownie absolutely loves coming here — even when we’re just walking by, he always tries to go inside 😁 I think that says a lot about how comfortable and happy he feels here.
The staff is always incredibly friendly, welcoming, and caring. It’s such a great feeling knowing that my dog is in good hands. We’re always happy with the experience and will definitely keep coming back! 🐶❤️
Highly recommend!

I took my recent rescue dog Rhubarb (toy poodle) here for a first visit today. She is very anxious of people and loud noises or sudden movements due to years of neglect. I did a lot of research for a place in Montreal that was good with nervous dogs, and had experience (as Rhubarb has never been professionally groomed before).

Spableen took the time to ask all about her, ask what I’d like (they left her wispy ear hairs as i requested! I love them), and were patient with Rhubarbs anxious reactions. She came out looking so beautiful, like a whole new dog! I almost cried.

I will definitely be bringing Rhubarb back here again. Thank you for taking wonderful care of her, for your patience, and for making her look so clean and adorable (I included a “before” photo at the end, so others can see the true results!)
Excellent experience! And wonderful grooming. I highly recommend it and will definitely go back!

SPAbleen took exceptional care of my dog, Stump. Their team truly understands how to handle anxious dogs with patience, calm energy, and expertise. Stump felt safe and well‑supported throughout his stay, and that means everything. I highly recommend SPAbleen to all dog owners looking for trustworthy. Thank you

I booked an appointment for a nail trim, specifying that I would use a Dremel tool on the booking form and on the phone. I mentioned it again upon arrival. My request was not honored. One nail was bleeding (which can happen), but no coagulant was applied. Frankly, this is unacceptable for a groomer.

We brought our dog here for the full grooming experience.  From the beginning - great location, really nice facility, friendly staff, and it all took just a little over two hours.  Definitely coming back again!  Thanks for the great work!
I went for the first time and I'm very satisfied with the result. Thank you.
Extremely satisfied with the entire service. The welcome and attention were excellent, both for the dog and for us. Thank you!

It was our dog’s first time at Spableen and it was such an amazing experience! The staff was attentive, professional and very kind. The attention to detail was wonderful (we got a report, pictures and our dog even got a treats bag)! Thank you so much, we’ll definitely be back!

I highly recommend Spableen.

My reactive rescue chihuahua mix, who has been “fired” by 2 other groomers and would not let me bathe him or clip his nails, did great at Spableen! The groomer said he was so sweet (which he is when he’s not reactive). She is truly a dog whisperer.

We’ll be back!
Cooper’s favorite spa! He had a great haircut and perfect for summer! :)
5-star service from start to finish. The owner  Mirelli is sweet and passionate for fur babies. Immaculate dog grooming and her boutique across the street is well equipped!

Spableen is such a great spa for my dog, they always treat her so well there and leave her looking so good! The receptionist Silvana helped me take care of Corgi  when she was ready until I arrived and is so sweet!!!!! I love coming to Spableen 🥰 Spableen and Pableen are the best!!!!!!! …
Great service and cut. Would recommend

Love the services at Spableen! I’ve been there several times already and every time my dog is taken with lots of care. They explained to me what kind of haircut is good for his type of coat. They are very transparent and always so nice to talk to.
Rio always comes out smelling divine with a shiny and clean coat!
A very nice experience, they understood what I wanted, my two cocker spaniels are extremely well groomed, I recommend this salon.
Such lovely staff , Roco loved it he’s a nervous type of dog and was so happy sitting on their laps as we picked him up not to mention his haircut looks so good he’s long haired

The groomer at Spableen did a great job on my little Banou. She was also very happy and comfortable with the staff to my surprise as she tends to snap and bite. I recommend! I can’t wait for next appointment and I will be bringing my second poodle too!
Fantastic groomers. Really took their time with my toy poodle.
my dog loves it here, everyone is super kind and patient. we’ll def keep coming back for the spa and cute haircut ;)

I’ve been bringing my dog here for a while and always received great comments about her, so I was really surprised and disappointed when they suddenly refused to groom her because of her age. Nothing about her has changed.. They mentioned their “experienced” groomer is away for a few months, which makes me question the experience of the staff currently on site. Very disappointing way to treat a loyal customer !
